page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 104 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, the instance provides dedicated, non-hyperthreaded execution resources, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing at the core level.

The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating data transfer for clustered environments.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.c6t.26xlarge is its low memory-to-vCPU ratio and the complete absence of local storage or GPU acceleration. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-bound workloads that require high parallel processing capacity but have modest memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, high-performance computing simulations, and CPU-intensive compilation tasks.
